title: 井の中の蛙、大海を目指す ～WELL TO SPACE～
tagline: 井戸を出たら、今度は宇宙でした。
coreMechanic: Hold JUMP to charge continuously, decide left/up/right before release, commit flight without midair steering; learn authored well, recover variable falls, read fixed takeoff wind in the sky

inputs.direction: hold arrows / A D, or hold left/right touch buttons; neither means straight up
inputs.jump: hold Space / central JUMP, release to launch; max charge holds until release
inputs.peek: hold Down / S / 下を見る

practice: Seven isolated charge/flight/landing lessons, including no-air correction and short preparation; no production BEST, score, chapters, credits or run records
bestStorage: maximum height in integer decimeters; no checkpoint or position persistence
jev: offline profile/schema and observed records only; no evaluation API invoked
humanReview: pending physical device and subjective experience

level.catchLedges: physical terrain near25,50,75m; not saved checkpoints
level.wind: fixed visible height zones; sampled at takeoff and locked until landing

telemetry: local bounded shared events with Game019 charge/landing/fall/section/wind/chapter details; no external transmission
